description: Get a principle's definition and every piece in the corpus that teaches it. This is the most powerful cross-domain query in the graph — a principle like 'local_rule_global_pattern' or 'path_dependence' or 'map_territory_gap_private_access' instantly surfaces every domain (biology, computation, physics, language, mind) that expresses the same underlying structure. Use list_principles first to find the right principle ID, then get_principle to see the full landscape.
name: get_principle
